tokens.name: koinu
tokens.description:
Koinu: The Final Inu, In the beginning, there was the dog.
Then came the Inu—Shiba, Doge, Kishu, and a thousand others that flooded the chain, each barking louder, each promising to be the one that would run forever. But the pack grew crowded. The howls turned into noise. Every new Inu was just another dog in a longer line, chasing the same moon with the same tired bark. Until the smallest one appeared. Koinu.
The Japanese word for puppy—子犬. Not the full-grown Inu that had already claimed its territory. The one still soft-pawed, still learning the shape of the world, still small enough to fit in one hand… and somehow already carrying the weight of everything that came before it. Koinu is not another dog coin, it is the last one.
